sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: AI data-center load growth is structurally re-rating US independent power producers (VST, CEG, NRG) as 24/7 clean firming contracts outcompete merchant volatility.

Indonesian renewables remain policy-capped and grid-constrained, forcing capital to migrate to US climate-tech equities for liquidity and tariff certainty.
sectors.ai: Buy the US solar/utility complex on the AI-driven power demand supercycle; FSLR's 12% surge confirms module pricing bottoming and IRA clarity. Rotate out of Indonesian renewables laggards (-1.54%) toward US-listed pure-plays (SEDG, ARRY, RUN) and IPPs (VST, CEG) with contracted PPAs. Expect 15-20% upside in next 6 months as grid bottlenecks ease and data-center load accelerates.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Regulatory stability and food-security policies are creating a supportive backdrop for domestic consumer manufacturers, reducing input-cost volatility and boosting margin predictability.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap FMCG names with confirmed volume breakouts (JELI, IATA, BACH) while avoiding large-cap laggards; the sector's mild aggregate gain masks strong rotational momentum into smaller consumer plays. Position for 2-4 week continuation as US-listed peers (+0.46%) confirm demand, but trim into any 15%+ single-day spikes to lock gains.
